ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "UNAUTHORIZED", message: error.description, correlationId: correlationId }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "BAD_REQUEST", message: error.description, correlationId: correlationId }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "INTERNAL_ERROR", message: "Unexpected error, see logs", correlationId: correlationId }

logger.doc:name: Log sync failure
logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] Sync failed ' ++ (vars.entityType default '') ++ ' ' ++ (vars.entityKey default '') ++ ': ' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default '') ++ ' - ' ++ (error.description default '')]

db:stored-procedure.doc:name: Log Sync Error
db:stored-procedure.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 var nonRetryableErrors = ["SAPB1_VALIDATION", "SCHEMA_NOT_HONOURED", "INVALID_SIGNATURE"] var replayableEntities = ["ORDER", "ACCOUNT"] var errorId = error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN" var message = error.description default "No description" --- { channel: vars.channel default "UNKNOWN", entityType: vars.entityType default "UNKNOWN", entityKey: vars.entityKey default correlationId, errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default "MULE") ++ ":" ++ errorId, errorMessage: if (sizeOf(message) > 3990) message[0 to 3989] else message, payloadJson: write(vars.sourceRecord default {}, "application/json", { indent: false }), isRetryable: (replayableEntities contains (vars.entityType default "")) and !(nonRetryableErrors contains errorId), correlationId: correlationId, retryOfErrorId: vars.retryErrorId }]

logger.doc:name: Log persistence failure
logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] Could not persist sync error to Azure SQL: ' ++ (error.description default '')]

db:stored-procedure.doc:name: Log Sync Audit
db:stored-procedure.db:input-parameters: #[{ channel: vars.channel, entityType: vars.entityType, entityKey: vars.entityKey, outcome: vars.outcome, targetRef: vars.targetRef, durationMs: (now() as Number { unit: "milliseconds" }) - (vars.startMillis default (now() as Number { unit: "milliseconds" })), correlationId: correlationId }]

logger.doc:name: Log audit failure
logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] Could not write audit row: ' ++ (error.description default '')]
